streetfront.method: Reviewed address/neighbor/street and original-roof correspondence selects an existing source edge. The OSM address node is identity evidence only; no OSM building way is invented.
streetfront.frontage_uncertainty: Satellite-derived outline may follow the roof edge rather than surveyed wall feet. Mapped front width is an approximate source scale.

facade_frame.photographic_axis_note: 2016/2022 facade photos place neighboring226 at the southwest/left end. Original clockwise ring edge3 runs northeast→southwest, so photo-left-to-right is the negative native edge tangent. Keep original vertices; use this explicit sign when comparing photo controls.
facade_frame.conversion: localENU = facade_origin + u*s + inward_v*depth; glTF=[east,height,-north]. Source winding is preserved; do not assume u is photo-left-to-right until viewing direction is checked.

identity_chain: 2016 licensed original shows a readable 222 plate on the main facade column and a separate 226 plate on adjacent southwest storefront.
Commons original description names a residential building at 北大街222号.
OSM node independently supplies the same street/house number and gallery name; its location lies at the southeast edge of a single source roof polygon.
The source polygon orientation matches the southeast-facing street facade and southwest-to-northeast house-number order.
Read-only independent overhead imagery visually places this polygon on a discrete rectangular pitched main roof; adjoining southwest storefront and riverfront structures have separate roof surfaces.
Adjacent Tai’an Bridge south, Fangsheng Bridge northeast and the Dianpu river bend to the northwest provide a second neighborhood check.
2022second licensed photograph independently confirms same222/226 arrangement,three main bays,railing/frieze/lions and legible上海市鹤龙美术馆entry sign.
limitations: The address POI is not a measured corner; its 1cm computed distance to a source edge is coincidence of coordinates and must not be advertised as centimeter accuracy.
Source geometry is satellite-derived East Asian Buildings, not a surveyed OSM building outline or a complete cadastral parcel.
The footprint is the small street-facing main block, not the entire historic residence/land parcel; rear annex/interior ownership remains unverified.
Public basemap acquisition date is unknown and imagery is reference-only, excluded from all redistributable packages.
The 8.579m existing height is a 2018 100m-cell GHSL mean and cannot be treated as a height measurement of this house.
